high_level_description: A 1600x900 local relationship study on a near-white background, featuring a large oak trunk with a low branch on the right and a single small terrier in a leather harness actively digging into a visible dirt hole at the trunk's base.

style_description.aesthetics: Minimalist structural diagram with clear spatial relationships
style_description.lighting: Flat, even illumination — no shadows or highlights

compositional_deconstruction.background: Plain near-white background filling entire canvas

elements.desc: Large vertical oak trunk — dark brown rectangle, width 80px, height ~600px, centered at x=1240, anchored at bottom y=900
Low oak branch — dark brown rectangle, width 20px, length 220px, angled from trunk top (x=1240, y=300) down-right to ~x=1440, y=550
Visible dirt hole — dark brown rounded rectangle, 240px wide × 140px tall, centered horizontally under trunk base at y=820
Terrier body — light tan ellipse, 140px wide × 90px tall, positioned straddling top-left of dirt hole
Terrier front left paw — dark brown circle, 40px diameter, placed to visibly contact top edge of dirt hole
Terrier front right paw — dark brown circle, 40px diameter, adjacent to left paw, both contacting dirt hole's top contour
Terrier head — light tan circle, 60px diameter, centered above body, slightly tilted forward to suggest digging posture
